libheif-1.23.2.mjs is the unmodified libheif-wasm/libheif-bundle.mjs
from the libheif-js 1.23.2 release. The adjacent files contain its
license notices. Winter Arc loads it on demand as a separate module.

Package: https://registry.npmjs.org/libheif-js/-/libheif-js-1.23.2.tgz
Build source and instructions: https://github.com/catdad-experiments/libheif-js
Upstream libheif source: https://github.com/strukturag/libheif
